title: Belief Engine: Making Agent Stance Auditable in LLM Deliberation
abstract: arXiv:2605.15343v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-based AI agents are increasingly used to simulate deliberative social interactions, including negotiation, conflict resolution, and multi-turn opinion exchanges. Simulating human-like opinion change calls for agents that balance existing beliefs with openness to new evidence, while making their responses to that evidence traceable. Current systems often make this difficult: agents may drift from assigned roles, echo an interaction partner, keep a stance despite contrary evidence, or appear to change because the prompt or retrieved context has changed. We introduce the Belief Engine (BE), a framework that uses "belief" in a Bayesian modelling sense, as a maintained evidential state over a proposition that is exposed as a scalar stance. BE extracts structured evidence, stores argument records, and updates the belief state through a Bayesian-inspired stance update in log-odds space with two interpretable controls: evidence uptake u

translated_title: 信念引擎：使智能体立场在大语言模型审议中可审计
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体正越来越多地被用于模拟审议性的社会互动，包括谈判、冲突解决和多轮意见交流。模拟类人的观点变化需要智能体能够在既有信念与对新证据的开放性之间取得平衡，同时使其对该证据的响应可追溯。当前系统往往使这一点变得困难：智能体可能偏离被分配的角色、附和互动对象、在面对相反证据时仍坚持原有立场，或者仅仅因为提示词或检索到的上下文发生变化而“看起来”改变了观点。我们提出了信念引擎，这是一个以贝叶斯建模意义使用“信念”概念的框架，即把信念作为对某一命题持续维护的证据状态，并以标量立场的形式对外呈现。BE提取结构化证据、存储论证记录，并通过在对数几率空间中受贝叶斯启发的立场更新机制来更新信念状态，该机制包含两个可解释的控制参数：证据吸收度u（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出信念引擎（BE）框架，将智能体立场建模为对命题的可审计贝叶斯证据状态，在对数几率空间中通过可解释参数进行更新，使LLM智能体在审议互动中的立场变化可追溯、可审计。
en_tdlr: Introduces the Belief Engine (BE), a framework that maintains an auditable Bayesian evidential state over propositions—updated in log-odds space with interpretable controls—to make LLM agent stance changes in deliberation traceable and auditable.
